subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow 24-hour cron timeline first, or require the broader daily/week calendar and rescheduling design before implementation?
rationale: This is a new Control UI product capability rather than a broken existing contract, and the open implementation candidate is partial and conflicting.

options.title: Accept Narrow Timeline First
options.body: Rebase or replace the linked PR against the current cron page, preserve current cron/status/i18n contracts, and track daily/week/drag-and-drop work separately.

options.title: Design Full Calendar Scope First
options.body: Pause the current branch and require an explicit design for daily mode, week view, stats, validation, and rescheduling before code lands.

options.title: Defer Core Calendar View
options.body: Leave the current list and run-history UI as the supported core experience until maintainers prioritize this surface.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Timeline First
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the linked PR against the current cron page, preserve current cron/status/i18n contracts, and track daily/week/drag-and-drop work separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron-page UI history makes steipete the strongest routing candidate for the product-scope decision.
